reviewStatus: Supporting editorial draft selected from existing content. The trust-small-choices message appears in the approved mockups.
voice: The elephant is a calm female protector. Each message addresses the user as you and supports self-trust, self-love, or feeling steady. No physical-safety guarantees or claims that the user must earn care.

affirmations.text: You can build trust in yourself, one small choice at a time.
You can take your own needs seriously.
You can make a choice and change your mind.
You can ask for help and keep your own voice.
You deserve care, even when you need a quieter day.
You do not have to earn kindness.
You can be on your own side, even today.
You can pause, notice what you need, and choose your next step.
You are allowed to move at your own pace.
You can leave some questions open for today.
You can notice what supports you right now.
You do not have to feel certain to give your next step some thought.
You do not have to settle everything in this moment.
